statement: Let m = len(grid) and n = len(grid[0]). Say the ball starting at column i exits at column k if there exist columns c_0,...,c_m such that c_0 = i, c_m = k, and for every r with 0 <= r < m: 0 <= c_r < n; if grid[r][c_r] = 1 then c_r < n-1, grid[r][c_r+1] = 1, and c_{r+1} = c_r+1; if grid[r][c_r] = -1 then c_r > 0, grid[r][c_r-1] = -1, and c_{r+1} = c_r-1. Whenever the function returns a result ans, len(ans) = n and for every i with 0 <= i < n: ans[i] = -1 if and only if there is no k with 0 <= k < n such that the ball starting at column i exits at column k; and for every k with 0 <= k < n, if the ball starting at column i exits at column k then ans[i] = k.
preconditions: Let m = len(grid) and n = len(grid[0]). The parameters satisfy m >= 1, n >= 1, m <= 100, n <= 100, every row of grid has length n, and for every r, c with 0 <= r < m and 0 <= c < n, grid[r][c] = 1 or grid[r][c] = -1.

statement: The function returns a result r (does not fail) for every grid satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: Let m = len(grid) and n = len(grid[0]). The parameters satisfy m >= 1, n >= 1, m <= 100, n <= 100, every row of grid has length n, and for every r, c with 0 <= r < m and 0 <= c < n, grid[r][c] = 1 or grid[r][c] = -1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, for every i with 0 <= i < len(ans), ans[i] = -1 or (0 <= ans[i] < len(grid[0])).
preconditions: Let m = len(grid) and n = len(grid[0]). The parameters satisfy m >= 1, n >= 1, m <= 100, n <= 100, every row of grid has length n, and for every r, c with 0 <= r < m and 0 <= c < n, grid[r][c] = 1 or grid[r][c] = -1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, len(ans) = n and for every i with 0 <= i < n: if i > 0 and grid[0][i] = -1 and grid[0][i-1] = -1 then ans[i] = i-1; if i < n-1 and grid[0][i] = 1 and grid[0][i+1] = 1 then ans[i] = i+1; in every other case ans[i] = -1.
preconditions: Let m = len(grid) and n = len(grid[0]). The parameters satisfy m >= 1, n >= 1, m <= 100, n <= 100, every row of grid has length n, and for every r, c with 0 <= r < m and 0 <= c < n, grid[r][c] = 1 or grid[r][c] = -1. Additionally, m = 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, len(ans) = n and for every i with 0 <= i < n, if either (grid[0][i] = 1 and (i = n-1 or (i < n-1 and grid[0][i+1] = -1))) or (grid[0][i] = -1 and (i = 0 or (i > 0 and grid[0][i-1] = 1))), then ans[i] = -1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result ans, len(ans) = n and for every i with 0 <= i < n, if ans[i] = -1, then there exist r with 0 <= r < m and columns c_0,...,c_r such that c_0 = i, for every q with 0 <= q < r: 0 <= c_q < n and either (grid[q][c_q] = 1 and c_q < n-1 and grid[q][c_q+1] = 1 and c_{q+1} = c_q+1) or (grid[q][c_q] = -1 and c_q > 0 and grid[q][c_q-1] = -1 and c_{q+1} = c_q-1), and at row r the ball is stuck: 0 <= c_r < n and either (grid[r][c_r] = 1 and (c_r = n-1 or (c_r < n-1 and grid[r][c_r+1] = -1))) or (grid[r][c_r] = -1 and (c_r = 0 or (c_r > 0 and grid[r][c_r-1] = 1))).
